job.title: Automation Tester
job.description:
About the Role

We're currently working with an ASX top 50 organisation who are looking for an Automation Test Engineer to join their Melbourne office on an initial 6-month contract.

You will be tasked with leading the automation efforts in terms of plans around framework & tool selection, collaboration & execution.

Key Responsibilities




  • Design, develop, and maintain automated test frameworks and scripts for web, mobile, and API applications.
  • Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines to ensure seamless and repeatable quality checks.
  • Identify, document, and track software defects through their lifecycle, collaborating with developers for timely resolution.
  • Perform regression, functional, performance, and integration testing across various environments.
  • Analyze test results and provide clear, actionable feedback to development and product teams.
  • Participate in requirement reviews and provide input on testability, coverage, and potential edge cases.
  • Continuously enhance automation frameworks, tools, and processes to improve test coverage and efficiency.
  • Contribute to QA best practices, documentation, and knowledge sharing within the team.

Required Qualifications




  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 2–5 years of experience in software quality assurance, with a focus on automation.
  • Proficiency in one or more programming/scripting languages (e.g., Java, Python, JavaScript, C#).
  • Experience with automation tools such as Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, TestNG, JUnit, or similar.
  • Familiarity with API testing tools (e.g., Postman, REST Assured).
  • Understanding of CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps).
  • Solid understanding of software testing principles, QA methodologies, and SDLC processes.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and strong attention to detail.

Preferred Qualifications




  • Experience with performance or load testing tools (e.g., JMeter, Gatling).
  • Exposure to containerization and cloud platforms (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes, AWS).
  • Knowledge of version control systems (e.g., Git).
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.

job.description:
Master Data Lead

Sydney | Hybrid

Contract



The Opportunity

  • We’re partnering with a leading large-scale consumer organisation on a high-priority data remediation initiative supporting several major technology and transformation programs.
  • We’re looking for an experienced Master Data Lead to assess the current data landscape, identify and diagnose data-quality issues, and establish a clear remediation roadmap and longer-term governance approach.

Skillset

  • Experience within retail, FMCG, supply chain, consumer or another high-volume operational environment
  • Strong SQL capability and confidence working hands-on with complex relational datasets.
  • Experience with data profiling, mapping, cleansing, validation and root-cause analysis.
  • Experience rationalising large or complex legacy datasets.
  • Strong understanding of parent-child / hierarchical Master Data structures.
  • Experience investigating data issues across multiple interconnected platforms.
  • Ability to translate technical findings into clear business and operational impacts.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills across both technical and non-technical teams.
  • Ability to independently lead a diagnostic/remediation workstream from problem identification through to recommendations and execution planning.

job.title: Sr Mechanical Engineer
job.description:
SENIOR MECHANICAL ENGINEER

LOCATION: Hayward, CA (Onsite)

SCHEDULE: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM

DURATION: 14-Month Contract

PAY: 63-68 USD per hour



Job Responsibilities:

In this role, you will lead engineering activities to qualify supplier relocations for DNA sequencing systems. You will ensure that mechanical components, assemblies, and manufacturing processes continue to meet the required design, quality, reliability, and performance standards when production moves to a new supplier or manufacturing location.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Leading supplier-relocation projects and developing qualification plans, requirements, schedules, budgets, and risk assessments.
  • Reviewing engineering drawings, specifications, bills of materials (BOMs), manufacturing processes, tooling, and inspection methods.
  • Working with suppliers to collect technical documentation, samples, inspection records, material certifications, and validation evidence.
  • Developing and executing verification and validation plans, dimensional inspections, functional testing, and process-capability studies.
  • Identifying and resolving supplier quality issues, qualification failures, and manufacturing-related problems.
  • Collaborating with Quality, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Regulatory, and Process Engineering teams to obtain necessary approvals.
  • Managing engineering change control, supplier approvals, documentation updates, and release-to-manufacturing activities.
  • Maintaining accurate qualification records and ensuring projects meet established timelines and budgets.

Essential Duties and Job Functions:

  • Assess the technical requirements involved in transferring manufacturing from one supplier or location to another.
  • Evaluate mechanical parts, assemblies, materials, and manufacturing processes to identify potential risks and technical gaps.
  • Review engineering drawings and apply Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing (GD&T) principles to ensure components meet design specifications.
  • Develop qualification requirements based on product performance, material properties, dimensional tolerances, and manufacturing capabilities.
  • Coordinate with suppliers to obtain qualification samples, material certifications, inspection results, and supporting documentation.
  • Plan and conduct verification and validation activities to confirm that relocated parts and processes meet established requirements.
  • Perform or coordinate dimensional and functional testing, measurement-system analysis, and process-capability studies.
  • Lead root-cause analysis and corrective actions for failed qualifications, supplier deviations, and technical issues.
  • Review qualification results with internal stakeholders and secure the required technical and quality approvals.
  • Manage engineering changes, supplier qualification documentation, part approvals, and lifecycle-management reviews.
  • Ensure qualified components and manufacturing processes are approved and ready for production.
  • Track project progress, manage competing priorities, communicate risks, and implement recovery plans when necessary.
  • Prepare clear technical reports and maintain complete, accurate engineering records.

Knowledge & Skills:

  • Strong knowledge of mechanical engineering principles, mechanical design, and precision assemblies.
  • Proficiency in SolidWorks, engineering drawings, and GD&T.
  • Understanding of materials, manufacturing methods, fabrication processes, tooling, and inspection techniques.
  • Knowledge of supplier qualification, manufacturing transfers, sustaining engineering, and verification and validation.
  • Ability to evaluate dimensional variation, material properties, and process capability in relation to product performance.
  • Experience with root-cause analysis, problem-solving, and corrective and preventive actions.
  • Familiarity with measurement-system analysis, dimensional inspection, functional testing, and process-capability studies.
  • Strong project management skills, including scheduling, risk management, budgeting, and documentation.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and technical communication skills.
  • Ability to work effectively with suppliers and cross-functional engineering, quality, manufacturing, and supply chain teams.
  • Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to independently manage multiple supplier-relocation projects and meet critical deadlines.
  • Familiarity with regulated manufacturing environments and engineering change-control processes.

Education & Experience:

  • Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering with at least 5 years of relevant experience, or
  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering with at least 8 years of relevant experience.
  • Experience in sustaining engineering, supplier quality, part qualification, or manufacturing transfer.
  • Experience in life sciences, medical devices, or another regulated industry preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience with mechanical design, SolidWorks, GD&T, precision assemblies, materials, and manufacturing processes.
  • Experience leading supplier technical investigations, root-cause analysis, and corrective actions.
  • Experience preparing engineering documentation and managing qualification activities through final approval.
  • Experience working with FDA-regulated products is a plus.
  • Previous should-cost analysis experience is a plus.

job.title: Fire Safety Engineer
job.description:
FIRE SAFETY SUBJECT MATTER EXPERT – BATTERY ENERGY STORAGE SYSTEMS (BESS)

LOCATION: Remote

SCHEDULE: Standard

DURATION: 12-Month Contract

PAY: $37-42/hr



Job Responsibilities:

In this role, you will serve as a Fire Safety Subject Matter Expert for utility-scale Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS). You will help ensure battery storage projects are designed, installed, and operated safely by reviewing fire safety systems, assessing potential hazards, and ensuring compliance with applicable codes and standards.




Key responsibilities include:

  • Reviewing UL 9540A test reports to evaluate battery fire behavior and potential hazards at cell, module, unit, and installation levels.
  • Evaluating and providing guidance on fire protection systems and safety designs for BESS manufacturers and projects.
  • Ensuring compliance with applicable UL standards, NFPA codes, International Fire Code (IFC), and other relevant safety requirements.
  • Overseeing project safety analyses, including Hazard Mitigation Analysis (HMA), Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA), heat flux analysis, and Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) simulations.
  • Building relationships with Fire Marshals, fire departments, first responders, regulatory authorities, and local communities.
  • Educating emergency responders and local authorities about BESS fire hazards, safety systems, and emergency response procedures.
  • Supporting consistent fire safety standards, documentation, and communication across all project locations.
  • Participating in industry task groups and technical committees to improve BESS safety codes and standards.
  • Developing standardized templates and reporting guidelines for third-party safety assessments and supplier evaluations.

Essential Duties and Job Functions:

  • Review and assess UL 9540A test reports to understand thermal runaway, fire propagation, and associated hazards.
  • Provide technical recommendations and guidance on BESS fire safety system designs.
  • Review project- and product-level designs to verify compliance with applicable fire safety codes and standards.
  • Evaluate hazard mitigation strategies and fire safety analyses to ensure risks are appropriately addressed.
  • Review heat flux calculations and CFD simulation results to understand potential fire spread and thermal impacts.
  • Coordinate with engineering teams, manufacturers, suppliers, and project stakeholders to resolve fire safety concerns.
  • Develop and deliver presentations and educational sessions for firefighters, first responders, Authorities Having Jurisdiction (AHJs), Public Utility Commissions (PUCs), and community representatives.
  • Explain BESS hazards, fire protection systems, system operating sequences, and Emergency Response Plans (ERPs) and Emergency Operations Plans (EOPs).
  • Travel to local jurisdictions to support stakeholder meetings, emergency preparedness, and public safety education.
  • Establish standardized fire safety guidance and communication practices across the organization.
  • Participate in industry committees to support the development and improvement of BESS fire safety codes and standards.
  • Create standardized templates for third-party analyses and technical reports to improve consistency, efficiency, and supplier onboarding.

Knowledge & Skills:

  • Strong understanding of fire safety engineering and utility-scale Battery Energy Storage Systems.
  • Knowledge of battery fire hazards, thermal runaway, fire propagation, and hazard mitigation strategies.
  • Experience reviewing UL 9540A test reports and BESS fire protection system designs.
  • Familiarity with applicable UL standards, NFPA codes, International Fire Code (IFC), and other relevant regulations.
  • Knowledge of HMA, FMEA, heat flux analysis, and CFD simulations.
  • Strong technical analysis, problem-solving, and risk assessment skills.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, including the ability to explain technical fire safety concepts to nontechnical audiences.
  • Ability to work effectively with engineering teams, manufacturers, suppliers, fire departments, and regulatory authorities.
  • Strong documentation, reporting, and standardization skills.
  • Ability to develop safety procedures, technical guidelines, and emergency response materials.
  • Willingness to travel locally for stakeholder engagement, training, and public safety education.

Education & Experience:

  • Relevant education or professional experience in Fire Protection Engineering, Fire Science, Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
  • Experience with fire safety assessments and battery energy storage systems preferred.
  • Experience reviewing UL 9540A test reports and evaluating BESS fire protection designs.
  • Familiarity with NFPA codes, IFC requirements, and applicable fire safety standards.
  • Experience with hazard analysis, FMEA, heat flux analysis, and CFD modeling preferred.
  • Experience working with fire departments, first responders, regulatory authorities, or other public safety stakeholders is an advantage.

job.title: Senior Pipeline Integrity & Corrosion Engineer
job.description:
Senior Pipeline Integrity & Corrosion Engineer

Location: Pico Rivera or Chatsworth, California

Employment Type: 12-Month Contract

Work Arrangement: Hybrid – 4 Days Onsite / 1 Day Remote

Pay Rate: Up to $96.22 per hour

About the Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced Senior Pipeline Integrity & Corrosion Engineer to support pipeline integrity, corrosion management, and asset reliability initiatives for a leading natural gas utility in Southern California.

This position will focus on evaluating pipeline conditions, assessing corrosion and mechanical defects, interpreting inspection data, and recommending appropriate mitigation and repair strategies to maintain the safe and reliable operation of natural gas infrastructure.

The successful candidate will bring extensive experience in Fitness-for-Service (FFS) assessments, in-line inspection (ILI), Direct Assessment (DA), and corrosion engineering, along with strong technical judgment and the ability to collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary engineering and operations teams.

Key Responsibilities

Pipeline Integrity & Fitness-for-Service

  • Perform engineering assessments of pipeline integrity, including corrosion, dents, cracks, and other mechanical damage features.

  • Conduct Fitness-for-Service evaluations using recognised assessment methodologies and tools, including API 579, RSTRENG, CorLAS, MAT-8, or equivalent approaches.

  • Analyse pipeline inspection and assessment results to determine asset condition, remaining strength, and appropriate mitigation requirements.

  • Evaluate pipeline defects and provide technically justified recommendations for repair, monitoring, or further investigation.

  • Support the development and implementation of pipeline integrity management strategies.

Corrosion Engineering & Mitigation

  • Evaluate internal and external corrosion mechanisms affecting natural gas pipelines and associated equipment.

  • Support the implementation and maintenance of corrosion prevention and mitigation programmes.

  • Assess cathodic protection systems and recommend improvements to corrosion control practices.

  • Investigate corrosion-related failures and contribute to root cause analysis and corrective actions.

  • Coordinate material investigations and technical evaluations to support long-term asset reliability.

Inspection, Assessment & Pipeline Repair

  • Review and interpret in-line inspection (ILI) data, Direct Assessment (DA) findings, and nondestructive evaluation (NDE) results.

  • Assess inspection findings to support engineering decisions regarding pipeline integrity and repair requirements.

  • Coordinate with inspection specialists, field personnel, and engineering teams to address identified integrity concerns.

  • Support pipeline repair planning and evaluation of appropriate remediation methods.

  • Contribute to pipeline inspection, maintenance, and integrity improvement activities.

Engineering Documentation & Collaboration

  • Prepare detailed engineering assessments, technical reports, recommendations, and supporting documentation.

  • Maintain accurate records of integrity evaluations, inspection findings, and corrosion mitigation activities.

  • Collaborate with engineering, operations, maintenance, and other stakeholders to resolve technical challenges.

  • Communicate complex engineering findings clearly to technical and nontechnical audiences.

  • Support continuous improvement initiatives related to pipeline safety, reliability, and integrity management.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Chemical, Electrical, or Civil Engineering.

  • Minimum 8 years of relevant engineering experience, preferably within natural gas transmission, distribution, pipeline integrity, or corrosion engineering.

  • Demonstrated experience conducting Fitness-for-Service evaluations for corrosion, dents, and crack-related pipeline defects.

  • Experience with recognised pipeline assessment methodologies such as API 579, RSTRENG, CorLAS, MAT-8, or equivalent tools.

job.title: Financial Crime Data Engineering Lead (snowflake, dbt)
job.description:
I'm looking for a technically strong Financial Crime Data Lead to take ownership of the data engineering capability supporting financial crime operations within a leading UK financial services organisation.

Deep, hands-on expertise in both Snowflake and dbt is absolutely essential for this position. This isn't a purely strategic or people management role. I'm looking for someone who has significant experience designing, building and optimising production data platforms using both technologies, and who can set the technical direction whilst remaining close to the engineering.

The role offers the opportunity to build a trusted financial crime data foundation, bringing together information across transaction monitoring, screening, onboarding, CRM and operational systems to improve data quality, regulatory controls, reporting and future AI capabilities

The role

You'll take technical ownership of the financial crime data platform, shaping its architecture, engineering standards and delivery whilst leading a focused data engineering capability.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Snowflake architecture and engineering: Own the design, implementation and optimisation of Snowflake environments, including warehouse architecture, schema design, performance tuning, security, access controls and cost optimisation.
  • dbt development and architecture: Establish and develop robust dbt transformation frameworks, including complex SQL models, incremental processing, macros, testing, documentation, lineage and CI/CD integration.
  • Hands-on data engineering: Design and build production-grade SQL and Python pipelines, integrating data from multiple internal and external platforms.
  • Data modelling: Develop scalable data models covering clients, entities, transactions, alerts, screening outcomes, risk ratings, investigations and audit records.
  • Data quality and governance: Establish automated testing, reconciliation, data lineage, monitoring and governance controls across sensitive financial crime datasets.
  • Technical leadership: Define engineering standards, review architectural decisions, mentor engineers and ensure delivery follows strong software engineering practices.
  • Financial crime integration: Bring together data from AML, KYC, transaction monitoring, screening, CRM and other operational systems.
  • AI and automation: Build reliable, well-governed datasets that support future machine learning, anomaly detection, alert optimisation and investigation automation.

What I'm looking for

The most important requirement is someone with genuine technical depth across Snowflake and dbt, backed by strong SQL/Python engineering and experience leading data platform delivery.

Essential experience:

  • Extensive, hands-on Snowflake engineering experience, including architecture, data modelling, performance optimisation, warehouse management, security and cost control.
  • Advanced dbt expertise, having designed and developed production transformation frameworks rather than simply worked with existing models.
  • Strong SQL skills, including complex transformations, query optimisation, data quality checks, reconciliation and scalable modelling techniques.
  • Strong Python engineering capabilities for pipelines, automation, API integrations, testing and reusable data processing.
  • Experience designing and delivering modern cloud data platforms in complex enterprise environments.
  • Strong understanding of data engineering best practices, including Git, CI/CD, automated testing, observability and production support.
  • Previous experience leading engineers, setting technical standards and taking ownership of architecture and delivery.
  • Experience working with sensitive, governed data in financial services or another highly regulated environment.

Particularly interesting experience:

  • Financial crime, AML, KYC, sanctions screening or transaction monitoring data.
  • Integrating financial crime platforms, CRM systems and third-party vendor APIs.
  • Data Vault, dimensional modelling or complex entity resolution.
  • Building data foundations for machine learning, anomaly detection or GenAI applications.
  • Experience with Azure Data Factory, Airflow or similar orchestration technologies.

Why consider it?

This is an opportunity to take genuine technical ownership of an important data engineering capability, rather than inherit an established platform with limited scope to influence its direction.

You'll help shape how financial crime data is structured, integrated, governed and consumed across the organisation, with the opportunity to introduce engineering standards, improve operational processes and enable future automation and AI use cases.

The role offers a combination of hands-on technical challenges, architectural ownership, leadership responsibilities and direct exposure to senior business and technology stakeholders.

Package: Up to £120,000 base salary, plus bonus, excellent pension and wider benefits.

Location: London, Glasgow or Liverpool, with hybrid working. London-based employees attend the office 2–3 days per week.

If you're a senior Data Engineer, Principal Data Engineer or Data Engineering Lead with substantial Snowflake and dbt experience, and you're interested in taking ownership of a business-critical data platform, I'd be keen to have a conversation.

About the Company
Hydrogen Group is partnering with one of the largest direct-hire industrial construction and EPC contractors in the U.S. They self-perform turnkey projects across power generation, refining, gas processing, chemical and petrochemical, hydrogen, and heavy industrial markets, from groundbreaking through commissioning and startup. The Workface Planner makes sure field crews have everything they need before work starts: approved drawings, materials, tools, equipment, scaffold, access, permits, and safety and quality requirements. Location: Pico Rivera or Chatsworth, California

Employment Type: 12-Month Contract

Work Arrangement: Hybrid – 4 Days Onsite / 1 Day Remote

About the Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced Senior Pipeline Integrity & Corrosion Engineer to support pipeline integrity, corrosion management, and asset reliability initiatives for a leading natural gas utility in Southern California.

This position will focus on evaluating pipeline conditions, assessing corrosion and mechanical defects, interpreting inspection data, and recommending appropriate mitigation and repair strategies to maintain the safe and reliable operation of natural gas infrastructure.

The successful candidate will bring extensive experience in Fitness-for-Service (FFS) assessments, in-line inspection (ILI), Direct Assessment (DA), and corrosion engineering, along with strong technical judgment and the ability to collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary engineering and operations teams.

Key Responsibilities

Pipeline Integrity & Fitness-for-Service

  • Perform engineering assessments of pipeline integrity, including corrosion, dents, cracks, and other mechanical damage features.
  • Conduct Fitness-for-Service evaluations using recognised assessment methodologies and tools, including API 579, RSTRENG, CorLAS, MAT-8, or equivalent approaches.
  • Analyse pipeline inspection and assessment results to determine asset condition, remaining strength, and appropriate mitigation requirements.
  • Evaluate pipeline defects and provide technically justified recommendations for repair, monitoring, or further investigation.
  • Support the development and implementation of pipeline integrity management strategies.

Corrosion Engineering & Mitigation

  • Evaluate internal and external corrosion mechanisms affecting natural gas pipelines and associated equipment.
  • Support the implementation and maintenance of corrosion prevention and mitigation programmes.
  • Assess cathodic protection systems and recommend improvements to corrosion control practices.
  • Investigate corrosion-related failures and contribute to root cause analysis and corrective actions.
  • Coordinate material investigations and technical evaluations to support long-term asset reliability.

Inspection, Assessment & Pipeline Repair

  • Review and interpret in-line inspection (ILI) data, Direct Assessment (DA) findings, and nondestructive evaluation (NDE) results.
  • Assess inspection findings to support engineering decisions regarding pipeline integrity and repair requirements.
  • Coordinate with inspection specialists, field personnel, and engineering teams to address identified integrity concerns.
  • Support pipeline repair planning and evaluation of appropriate remediation methods.
  • Contribute to pipeline inspection, maintenance, and integrity improvement activities.

Engineering Documentation & Collaboration

  • Prepare detailed engineering assessments, technical reports, recommendations, and supporting documentation.
  • Maintain accurate records of integrity evaluations, inspection findings, and corrosion mitigation activities.
  • Collaborate with engineering, operations, maintenance, and other stakeholders to resolve technical challenges.
  • Communicate complex engineering findings clearly to technical and nontechnical audiences.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives related to pipeline safety, reliability, and integrity management.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Chemical, Electrical, or Civil Engineering.
  • Minimum 8 years of relevant engineering experience, preferably within natural gas transmission, distribution, pipeline integrity, or corrosion engineering.
  • Demonstrated experience conducting Fitness-for-Service evaluations for corrosion, dents, and crack-related pipeline defects.
  • Experience with recognised pipeline assessment methodologies such as API 579, RSTRENG, CorLAS, MAT-8, or equivalent tools.
  • Advanced understanding of in-line inspection (ILI), Direct Assessment (DA), and nondestructive evaluation (NDE) methods.
  • Experience interpreting pipeline inspection results and developing technically sound integrity and repair recommendations.
  • Strong understanding of pipeline corrosion mechanisms, mitigation strategies, and integrity management practices.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, documentation, and communication skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to work effectively across multidisciplinary teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • NACE CP1 / AMPP Cathodic Protection Level 1 certification.
  • Experience supporting natural gas utility pipeline integrity programmes.
  • Familiarity with cathodic protection systems, pipeline repair methods, and corrosion control strategies.
  • Experience investigating pipeline defects, material degradation, and equipment failures.
  • Knowledge of applicable pipeline integrity standards and regulatory requirements.

job.title: GSE Combination Welder III
job.description:
GSE Combination Welder

Hydrogen Group is hiring on behalf of a confidential client in the aerospace and space technology industry for a GSE Combination Welder to support the fabrication, assembly, and modification of ground support equipment and flight-grade stainless steel components.

This position will work on a variety of projects, including equipment used for research and development testing, launch site infrastructure, and production tooling. The successful candidate will interpret engineering drawings, perform multiple welding processes, and collaborate with engineering, design, and operations teams to ensure fabricated components meet quality and performance standards.

Location: Briggs, TX, just north of Austin/Cedar Park.

Key Responsibilities

  • Complete welding and fabrication assignments in accordance with established procedures, technical specifications, and quality standards.

  • Weld aluminum and steel structures, piping, and assemblies using applicable processes, including TIG, MIG, and stick welding.

  • Interpret engineering blueprints and technical drawings to plan layouts, prepare materials, and complete welds to specified dimensions and tolerances.

  • Review piping and instrumentation diagrams, shop drawings, and related documentation to support equipment installation, troubleshooting, and repairs.

  • Install and modify tubing, piping, and conduit associated with fluid systems and equipment upgrades.

  • Use precision measuring instruments and mechanical tools, including torque wrenches, calipers, micrometers, plug gauges, and pin gauges, to verify dimensions, identify issues, and maintain equipment to required standards.

  • Conduct safety inspections and operate equipment such as forklifts and boom lifts when needed.

  • Maintain a clean, organized work area and contribute to ongoing site improvement efforts.

  • Travel to launch facilities as required to support project and program needs.

Basic Qualifications

  • High school diploma or GED.

  • At least 3 years of relevant welding experience.

  • Hands-on experience with MIG, TIG, stick, and flux-core welding processes.

  • Background in both structural and pipe welding.

  • Understanding of heat input, heat distribution, and thermal management techniques used to minimize distortion during welding.

  • Familiarity with standard fabrication shop practices, including layout, drilling, sawing, and grinding.

  • Experience operating forklifts, cranes, or other industrial machinery; lifting and rigging experience is preferred.

  • Availability to work overtime and weekends as business needs require.

  • Ability to lift at least 50 pounds without assistance.

  • Ability to bend, stoop, crawl, work in confined or restricted spaces, and perform tasks on elevated structures.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 5 or more years of relevant welding experience.

  • Experience fabricating and welding stainless steel cryogenic piping systems.

  • Strong mechanical troubleshooting skills, including the ability to identify equipment issues, determine appropriate solutions, and resolve problems efficiently.

Required Weld Test

Candidates should be prepared to complete the following welding assessments:

TIG Welding

  • 2-inch Schedule 10 stainless steel pipe in the 6G position.

  • 2-inch Schedule 160 stainless steel pipe in the 6G position.

Stick / Flux-Core Welding

  • Carbon steel tee plate weld in vertical and overhead positions using stick welding.

  • Carbon steel tee plate weld in vertical and overhead positions using flux-core welding.

Our client, a medical device organization, is seeking a Senior Engineer, R&D Sustainment to support the lifecycle management of on-market Class III implantable medical devices. Working alongside Quality and Manufacturing teams, you will investigate field and manufacturing issues, implement design and process improvements, and support engineering change assessments. Your work will help ensure continued product safety, performance, reliability, manufacturability, and regulatory compliance for devices that improve outcomes for patients with heart failure.




Job Responsibilities:

In this role, you will manage and support a variety of projects within the R&D Engineering department, focused on the post-market sustainment of Class III implantable devices. Key responsibilities include:




Essential Job Duties and Job Functions:

  • Issue Resolution and Root Cause Investigation: Lead investigations into device field issues by analyzing product performance data, customer feedback, and failure reports. Define and execute engineering studies and testing to determine root cause and support effective actions that minimize device downtime and customer impact.
  • Design and Process Improvement: Partner with R&D and Manufacturing to identify and lead design changes and process improvements that enhance device reliability, performance, and manufacturability.
  • Product Performance Monitoring: Monitor device performance and quality metrics, and develop and execute plans to address deviations from expected performance.
  • Design Changes and Change Control: Lead design and process changes for on-market devices, including design impact assessments, documentation, requirements and specification updates, verification planning, change control implementation, and assessment of labeling and risk impacts.
  • Risk Management: Lead updates to design FMEAs, hazard analyses, and risk management files. Evaluate whether issues or changes introduce new hazards, affect existing risk controls, or require additional mitigation, verification, or validation.
  • Verification and Validation (V&V): Develop, review, and execute test plans, protocols, reports, and test methods to support product changes, manufacturing improvements, complaint investigations, CAPAs, and regulatory responses. Analyze results using appropriate engineering and statistical methods to ensure objective evidence supports design change decisions.
  • Documentation and Compliance: Maintain accurate, comprehensive records of engineering changes, investigations, technical reports, test records, risk documentation, and change control. Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and company standards, and collaborate with Quality and Regulatory on regulatory requests.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Manufacturing, Quality Assurance, Regulatory Affairs, Clinical Development, suppliers, and other engineering teams to support product lifecycle management.
  • Assign R&D support tasks and train, coach, and guide lower-level employees on routine procedures.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Knowledge and Skills:

  • Experience with ISO 13485, ISO 14971, FDA quality management system regulations, and applicable medical device regulatory expectations
  • Experience developing or executing verification and validation protocols, engineering test methods, and technical reports
  • Working knowledge of medical device design controls, change control, CAPA, complaint investigations, and risk management
  • Proficiency in engineering software and statistical tools for design and data analysis, in particular Python, Minitab, and Excel
  • Experience with CAD, engineering specifications, tolerance analysis, and hardware design documentation (preferred)
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document technical rationale and present findings to cross-functional stakeholders
  • Solid problem-solving, organizational, analytical, and critical thinking skills
  • Attention to detail and commitment to high-quality documentation
  • Ability to work effectively in a team-oriented, fast-paced, regulated environment while managing multiple priorities
  • Adherence to all company rules and requirements, including Environmental Health & Safety rules, and use of appropriate control measures to prevent injury and protect the environment

Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering or a Scientific field with 4 years of experience, OR Master’s Degree or equivalent in Engineering or a Scientific field with 3 years of experience, OR Ph.D. or equivalent in Engineering or a Scientific field
  • Experience supporting on-market medical devices, preferably Class III implantable or electromechanical devices (preferred)

job.title: Interconnection Coordinator – Energy Projects
job.description:
Interconnection Coordinator – Energy Projects

Location: Remote – United States (travel approximately twice per quarter)

Contract: 12 Months

Pay Rate: $37.47 per hour

Schedule: Standard Office Hours

About the Opportunity

We are seeking a detail-oriented Interconnection Coordinator to support the delivery of major energy infrastructure and power generation projects across the United States.

This opportunity will involve coordinating contractual deliverables associated with Power Purchase Agreements (PPA), Interconnection Agreements (IA), and Generator Interconnection Agreements (GIA), ensuring critical project obligations are documented, tracked and completed within agreed deadlines.

Working closely with corporate project teams, construction personnel and transmission stakeholders, you will play an important role in supporting project compliance, reporting and successful interconnection activities.

This position would suit someone with experience in utility project coordination, contract administration, project controls or infrastructure project management.

Key Responsibilities

Interconnection & Contract Coordination

  • Review Power Purchase Agreements (PPA) and Interconnection Agreements (IA) to identify contractual requirements, project obligations and submission deadlines.

  • Develop and maintain comprehensive registers of contractual deliverables for review by Interconnection Specialists.

  • Coordinate documentation and submissions with Transmission Owners, Transmission Operators and PPA stakeholders.

  • Monitor interconnection milestones and ensure contractual deliverables remain aligned with project schedules.

Project Controls & Reporting

  • Import, maintain and update contractual deliverables within project controls systems.

  • Track submission deadlines, outstanding actions and critical-path activities associated with interconnection requirements.

  • Prepare weekly and monthly progress reports highlighting deliverable status, upcoming milestones and potential schedule risks.

  • Support accurate project documentation, reporting and compliance tracking.

Stakeholder Coordination

  • Collaborate with construction site teams, corporate project personnel and Transmission Services.

  • Participate in regular Generator Interconnection Agreement (GIA) dashboard meetings.

  • Prepare meeting materials, maintain action logs and follow up on outstanding deliverables.

  • Establish effective working relationships with internal and external stakeholders to support timely project execution.

Systems & Process Management

  • Support the administration of contractual deliverables within Oracle Primavera Unifier or comparable project controls platforms.

  • Assist with agreement-related task imports, system updates and reporting improvements.

  • Maintain accurate project records and contribute to continuous improvement of interconnection tracking processes.

Required Skills & Experience

  • Experience in project coordination, contract administration, project controls or a related discipline.

  • Ability to interpret contractual documentation and identify deliverables, obligations and critical deadlines.

  • Strong understanding of contract terminology and document management processes.

  • Excellent organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple time-sensitive project deliverables.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

  • High attention to detail and accuracy in reporting and documentation.

  • Ability to work independently, prioritise workloads and meet project deadlines.

  • Proficiency with project tracking tools, reporting systems and Microsoft Office applications.

Preferred Experience

  • Previous experience supporting utilities, renewable energy, power generation, transmission or large-scale infrastructure projects.

  • Familiarity with Power Purchase Agreements (PPA), Interconnection Agreements (IA) or Generator Interconnection Agreements (GIA).

  • Experience working with Transmission Owners, Transmission Operators or utility interconnection teams.

  • Working knowledge of Oracle Primavera Unifier or similar project controls software.

  • Experience maintaining contractual deliverable registers, project dashboards and critical milestone reporting.

Contract Details

  • Pay: $37.47 per hour

  • Duration: Initial 12-month contract

  • Location: Remote within the United States

  • Travel: Approximately twice per quarter to project sites or corporate offices

  • Working Hours: Standard business hours

Why Apply?

This is an opportunity to support major US energy infrastructure projects while gaining exposure to utility interconnection processes, transmission stakeholders and large-scale power generation developments.

The role offers remote working, varied project responsibilities and the opportunity to work alongside experienced energy and infrastructure professionals.

Apply today to learn more about this Interconnection Coordinator opportunity.

job.title: Application Security Engineer
job.description:
We're looking for an Application Security Engineer to join the Software Engineering group at our financial services client in Sydney. Your job is to build on an already developed engineering practice and then begin to look at data, investment and digital engineering teams. You’ll make sure security findings are prioritised by real risk, fixed, and tracked until the fix is verified.

What you’ll be doing

  • Reviewing results from application security tools covering SAST, DAST, SCA, secrets, API, container and infrastructure-as-code scanning, confirming genuine impact and weeding out false positives, duplicates and recurring root causes
  • Ranking findings by severity, exploitability, how critical and exposed the asset is, and the business context, in line with the vulnerability management process
  • Giving engineers clear, practical fix guidance, and keeping a traceable record from each finding to its remediation ticket, owner, due date, exception and closure evidence
  • Owning secure SDLC controls from design through to ongoing maintenance, including the control requirements, implementation guidance, evidence expectations and reviews of whether the controls work
  • Overseeing GitHub security and related integrations: repository baselines, access reviews, branch protection, pull-request rules, code ownership, secrets protection, scanning, status checks, ticketing and exception handling
  • Reporting on the health, risk and trends of the remediation backlog, escalating overdue or blocked items, verifying completed fixes, keeping security records up to date, and managing risk exemptions from approval through to review or expiry

What you’ll bring

  • Strong analytical skills and a track record of triaging and prioritising application security findings
  • Working knowledge of SAST, DAST, SCA, secrets, API, container and infrastructure-as-code scanning, plus OWASP Top 10, API Security Top 10, common CWEs and software supply-chain risks
  • Experience defining, implementing and assessing secure SDLC controls across the full lifecycle
  • The ability to turn technical findings into clear, actionable guidance for engineering teams
  • Experience with vulnerability management workflows, ticketing, backlog management, reporting and evidence-based closure
  • Deep GitHub security knowledge, including repository governance, access models, branch protection, pull-request controls, code ownership, GitHub’s security features and application security integrations
  • Strong stakeholder engagement, written communication and follow-through

  • Hands-on experience using oscilloscopes, power supplies, digital multimeters and other electronic laboratory equipment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with mixed-signal oscilloscopes and advanced electronic measurement equipment.

  • Previous experience testing automotive electronic systems or automotive instrumentation.

  • Familiarity with semiconductor post-silicon validation and processor bring-up.

  • Experience developing, maintaining or troubleshooting automated validation test setups.

  • Knowledge of environmental testing, thermal chambers and electrical performance testing.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint and Visio.

  • Experience working directly with electrical, hardware and silicon engineering teams.

Why Apply?

  • Work on advanced automotive electronics and autonomous processing technology.

  • Gain exposure to complex post-silicon validation and hardware development activities.

  • Collaborate with experienced silicon and electronics engineering teams.

  • Competitive hourly contract rate with potential for extension.

Apply today if you are an experienced electronics validation technician with strong laboratory testing skills and an interest in advanced automotive technology.

Investment Analyst



Day Rate Contract | Sydney | 6 months



· We are partnering with a leading Australian financial services organisation looking for an experienced Investment Analyst to join its Investments function.

· This is not a traditional Business Analyst or pure Data Analyst position. The team is looking for an investment generalist who can work across investment analysis, data, reporting and business processes, moving between different areas depending on the needs of the investment team.



Role

· Working closely with stakeholders across Investments, Data and Technology, you will support a broad range of investment and business process initiatives.



Key responsibilities

· Work across a range of initiatives within the Investments function, providing analytical, data and process support.

· Analyse investment and portfolio data to support investment teams and business decision-making.

· Work with fund structures, investment products, portfolios and investment data across multiple asset classes.

· Use SQL to interrogate, validate and analyse investment data.

· Work with investment and market data platforms including FactSet.

job.description:
Principal IT Program Manager & Product Owner

Location: Oakland, CA (1 day per week onsite)

Pay Range: $85-$92/hr

Duration: 13-month contract (through end of 2027)




Position Summary

The Principal IT Program Manager & Product Owner role is responsible for defining product strategy, managing complex multi-year technology programs, and ensuring delivery of business outcomes across a portfolio of IT products and services. This position serves as the bridge between business stakeholders, technology teams, architecture, cybersecurity, operations, and executive leadership.

The role owns product vision, roadmap development, strategic planning, portfolio governance, funding, prioritization, and delivery execution. The Principal IT Program Manager & Product Owner drives modernization initiatives, aligns technology investments with business objectives, and ensures products deliver measurable value, reliability, security, and operational excellence.




Key Responsibilities

Product Strategy & Ownership

  • Define and maintain product vision, strategy, and long-term roadmap.
  • Serve as Product Owner for strategic technology products and platforms.
  • Develop and prioritize product backlogs based on business value, risk, compliance, and operational requirements.
  • Translate business needs into product requirements, epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
  • Drive product lifecycle management, including modernization, technical debt reduction, and technology refresh initiatives.
  • Establish and monitor product KPIs, service metrics, and value realization measurements.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend strategic investments.

    Program & Portfolio Management
  • Lead large-scale, cross-functional technology programs with enterprise-wide impact.
  • Manage multiple concurrent projects and initiatives within an assigned portfolio.
  • Develop multi-year strategic plans, investment roadmaps, and delivery schedules.
  • Oversee program governance, issue escalation, risk management, and executive reporting.
  • Ensure alignment of program objectives with enterprise and IT strategic goals.
  • Track benefits realization and drive continuous improvement across the portfolio.
  • Lead quarterly and annual planning activities.

    Financial & Resource Management
  • Develop and manage portfolio budgets, forecasts, and funding strategies.
  • Perform resource planning across internal teams, contractors, vendors, and managed service providers.
  • Monitor financial performance and ensure effective use of technology investments.
  • Develop business cases and investment recommendations for executive review.
  • Manage vendor relationships, contracts, and service performance.

    Stakeholder & Executive Engagement
  • Partner with business leaders, IT executives, architecture teams, and operational stakeholders.
  • Present portfolio health, strategic recommendations, risks, and funding requirements to leadership.
  • Facilitate decision-making and alignment across multiple organizations.
  • Develop strong relationships with key stakeholders to ensure product and program success.
  • Lead communication and change management activities for complex initiatives.

    Delivery Leadership
  • Ensure successful delivery of technology solutions from concept through implementation and operational transition.
  • Coordinate across product, engineering, cybersecurity, infrastructure, architecture, and operations teams.
  • Remove organizational barriers and resolve complex program issues.
  • Establish delivery standards, governance processes, and performance expectations.
  • Drive Agile, Hybrid, and Waterfall delivery methodologies as appropriate.

    Leadership & Mentoring
  • Provide mentorship and guidance to Program Managers, Project Managers, Scrum Masters, Product Owners, and emerging leaders.
  • Promote a culture of accountability, innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor and subject matter expert across the organization.
  • Lead strategic initiatives and special assignments requiring executive-level judgment.




    Required Qualifications

    Education
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Master's degree preferred.

    Experience
  • 12+ years of technology program, portfolio, project, or product management experience.
  • 8+ years leading large-scale enterprise technology initiatives.
  • Proven experience managing complex, cross-functional programs with significant budgets and executive visibility.
  • Experience serving as Product Owner, Product Manager, Program Manager, or Portfolio Manager.
  • Demonstrated success leading digital transformation, infrastructure modernization, cloud migration, application modernization, or technology lifecycle management initiatives.

    Certifications (Preferred)
  • PMP (Project Management Professional)
  • PMI-ACP
  • Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO)
  • SAFe Product Manager/Product Owner (POPM)
  • SAFe Program Consultant (SPC)
  • ITIL Foundation or higher




    Knowledge, Skills & Abilities
  • Advanced understanding of product management and Agile methodologies.
  • Expert knowledge of program and portfolio management principles.
  • Strong financial planning, forecasting, and budget management capabilities.
  • Exceptional executive communication and presentation skills.
  • Strategic planning and roadmap development expertise.
  • Strong stakeholder management and influence skills.
  • Experience leading in a matrixed organization.
  • Risk management, governance, and compliance expertise.
  • Vendor and contract management experience.
  • Ability to balance business priorities, operational requirements, and technology strategy.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Proven ability to lead organizational change and drive adoption.




    Key Deliverables
  • Product Vision & Strategy
  • Multi-Year Technology Roadmap
  • Portfolio Investment Plan
  • Product Backlog & Prioritization Framework
  • Financial Forecasts & Budget Plans
  • Executive Status Reports
  • Benefits Realization Dashboard
  • KPI and Service Performance Metrics
  • Risk & Issue Management Plans
  • Governance and Compliance Reporting
  • Lifecycle Management Plans




    Success Measures
  • Delivery of strategic business outcomes
  • Product adoption and customer satisfaction
  • Portfolio financial performance
  • On-time and on-budget program execution
  • Reduction of technical debt and operational risk
  • Achievement of service reliability and operational targets
  • Stakeholder satisfaction and executive confidence
  • Successful execution of lifecycle initiatives

job.title: Clinical Trial Consultant
job.description:
CLINICAL TRIAL CONSULTANT / PHARMACOVIGILANCE SPECIALIST

LOCATION: Remote (EST preferred)

SCHEDULE: Standard EST hours, 40 hours per week

DURATION: 12-month contract

PAY: $55-60/hour



Job Responsibilities:

In this role, you will manage and support the processing and quality control (QC) of clinical trial Individual Case Safety Reports (ICSRs) and postmarketing safety cases originating from sanctioned countries. Key responsibilities include:

  • Managing the triage, intake, case entry, and QC of ICSRs from sponsored clinical studies or other assigned cases.
  • Preparing case narratives, performing MedDRA coding, drafting follow-up queries, and communicating event notifications to internal stakeholders.
  • Conducting retrospective quality checks on processed cases to ensure accuracy, completeness, and compliance.
  • Independently managing assigned cases to meet internal deadlines and support timely regulatory reporting, including coverage for weekends and holidays.
  • Reviewing and resolving reconciliation discrepancies between clinical and safety databases in collaboration with Data Management.
  • Providing investigation details and supporting documentation for late regulatory reporting of clinical trial cases.

Essential Duties and Job Functions:

  • Perform end-to-end ICSR processing, including case triage, intake, data entry, and quality review.
  • Ensure case documentation, narratives, and medical coding meet established quality standards and regulatory requirements.
  • Draft appropriate follow-up queries to obtain missing or additional safety information.
  • Prepare and distribute event notifications to relevant internal stakeholders.
  • Conduct retrospective QC reviews to identify errors, discrepancies, and opportunities for process improvement.
  • Monitor case timelines and independently prioritize workloads to ensure timely case completion and regulatory submission.
  • Coordinate with Data Management to investigate and resolve discrepancies between clinical trial and safety databases.
  • Investigate and document the root causes and relevant details associated with late regulatory reporting of clinical trial cases.
  • Maintain compliance with applicable global and local pharmacovigilance regulations, guidelines, and company procedures.
  • Ensure accurate and complete safety case documentation to support audit readiness and regulatory compliance.

Knowledge & Skills:

  • Strong knowledge of global and local pharmacovigilance regulations and safety reporting requirements.
  • Understanding of FDA, ICH, and European Union pharmacovigilance regulations and guidelines.
  • Hands-on experience processing ICSRs using safety database systems such as ArisG, Argus, and Veeva.
  • Knowledge of clinical trial and postmarketing safety case processing requirements.
  • Proficiency in medical terminology, clinical concepts, and medical practices.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including narrative writing and preparation of follow-up queries.
  • Excellent attention to detail and the ability to identify and resolve data discrepancies.
  • Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to independently manage multiple cases and competing priorities in a deadline-driven environment.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, including Data Management and internal safety stakeholders.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.
  • Ability to manage case processing timelines while accounting for weekends, holidays, and regulatory reporting deadlines.

Education & Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in a science, healthcare, or related field.
  • Minimum of 4 years of experience in pharmacovigilance.
  • Demonstrated experience in ICSR processing and quality control.
  • Experience with safety database systems such as ArisG, Argus, or Veeva.
  • Working knowledge of global safety reporting regulations and pharmacovigilance guidelines.
  • Experience with clinical trial safety cases and postmarketing case processing preferred.
  • Experience with case reconciliation, retrospective quality checks, and investigation of late regulatory reporting preferred.

Pay: $25.00-$33.00/hr

The Prevailing Wage and Apprenticeship Compliance Specialist will support renewable energy projects by ensuring compliance with prevailing wage, apprenticeship, and contractual labor requirements. Responsibilities include reviewing contractor data and certified payroll records, conducting audits, researching discrepancies, and reporting findings to management.

The specialist will identify project-specific requirements, communicate them to responsible parties, maintain compliance dashboards, and serve as the primary point of contact for prevailing wage and apprenticeship compliance matters.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review contractor data related to prevailing wage and apprenticeship requirements for completeness and accuracy.
  • Compare submitted data against project tax and finance stipulations and applicable contract exhibits.
  • Review payroll records to verify correct wage payments, fringe benefit contributions, and fulfillment of contractual labor compliance requirements.
  • Gather certified payroll records and supporting documentation, conduct detailed audits, and research discrepancies.
  • Prepare compliance status reports, audit findings, deficiency reports, and corrective action notes for management.
  • Update dashboards regularly to support compliance reporting.
  • Identify project-specific compliance requirements and communicate them to the individuals responsible for meeting them.
  • Provide compliance support and serve as the primary point of contact for prevailing wage labor requirements.
  • Present findings to senior management and host meetings to discuss compliance status.
  • Attend recurring meetings with contractors, subcontractors, and third-party consultants.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher.
  • Experience using LCP Tracker.
  • Strong proficiency with technical databases.
  • Strong attention to detail and analytical skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently, take initiative, and manage time effectively.

Preferred Qualifications

job.title: Senior AWS DevOps Engineer, Data and AI Platforms
job.description:
Location: Houston, TX (Downtown), fully onsite 5 days per week, local candidates only

Duration: 6-Month Contract (W2)

Schedule: Standard Business Hours, 40 hours per week

Pay Rate: $99.00 - $103.00/hr






Position Summary




Our client, a leading midstream energy company headquartered in Houston, TX, seeks a Senior (Level III) DevOps Engineer to design, build, and run the DevOps capability for its AI and Data Engineering teams on AWS. Working directly with internal customers, this individual will design and document the overall DevOps solution architecture, then build the CI/CD pipelines, automation, and deployment paths that Data, ML, and AI Engineers use to ship data products, ML models, and GenAI applications. The ideal candidate knows the data engineering space well (how Snowflake, dbt, and Airflow workloads are built, tested, promoted, and operated) and understands what it takes to take an ML or GenAI service to production.




Working with minimal supervision alongside Security, Compliance, Data Engineering, AI Engineering, and the wider DevOps team, the engineer will establish reusable, templated practices with required gates and governance built in, making the compliant path the easiest path for developers. This role suits a daily, proficient user of AI-assisted engineering tools who will help shape how the team uses AI. All work is documented and handed over so the client's DevOps staff can operate and extend it.




Essential Functions and Responsibilities

  • Initially, help automate Security and Compliance processes into the CI/CD pipelines and the client's compliance tool using Terraform, Python, and Shell
  • Build the first reusable, templated CI/CD paths for data and AI workloads, with the required gates and evidence included
  • Take over DevOps work currently handled within the Data Engineering team
  • Establish baseline observability and the first runbooks for the data and AI platform, and identify the highest-toil processes to automate first
  • Collaborate with internal customers (Data, ML and AI Engineering teams and their stakeholders) to understand their needs, then design and document the overall DevOps solution architecture: delivery paths, environments, gates, tooling and operating model; record design decisions and their rationale so others can extend the design
  • Own CI/CD and deployment automation for data and AI workloads: Snowflake and dbt change promotion, Airflow/Astronomer DAG deployment, and ML model and GenAI service release, across AWS, containerized clusters and on-premises environments
  • Partner with the Infrastructure Platform Engineering team on Infrastructure as Code (AWS CloudFormation, Terraform/OpenTofu, CDK) for multi-account AWS environments, and incorporate it into pipelines for data and AI platform services (S3, Glue, Athena, Lake Formation, SageMaker, Bedrock, Lambda, ECS, RDS, IAM, VPC)
  • Automate CloudFormation stack/change set and Terraform plan/apply deployments, testing, and evidence
  • Support MLOps practices, including model registries, pipeline automation, promotion across environments, and cost and guardrail controls for LLM-based systems
  • Build reusable, versioned, templated pipelines and workflows that teams adopt rather than copy, with security and compliance controls built in by default
  • Implement and automate required gates (approvals, segregation of duties, policy-as-code, scanning, change-ticket linkage) and produce auditable deployment evidence, working directly with Security and Compliance
  • Make developer experience a first-class goal through self-service tooling, fast feedback, clear errors and good documentation, so the governed route is also the easiest; measure and improve it
  • Build observability (metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, actionable alerting) and apply site reliability practices (SLIs/SLOs, capacity and cost review, disaster recovery testing, incident response and blameless post-incident reviews)
  • Write and maintain tested runbooks (daily operations, periodic maintenance, failure modes, recovery) that other team members can use, and turn them into automation wherever possible
  • Continuously reduce DevOps overhead by finding manual, repetitive, and high-volume work, then automating, simplifying, or eliminating it
  • Use AI-assisted development tools daily to design, build, test, and refactor automation, and contribute to standards for AI-assisted DevOps, including critical human review of generated output
  • Maintain collaborative working relationships with Data Development Engineers, Infrastructure Platform Engineers, and Security and Compliance team members, and mentor mid-level and junior engineers
  • Meet with executives on assigned projects and work with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Occasional travel to West Houston




Education/Experience

  • 10+ years in DevOps, platform, infrastructure, or site reliability engineering, including experience leading or mentoring other engineers
  • 5+ years in the AWS ecosystem as a DevOps or platform engineer, with deep AWS expertise
  • 5+ years with Infrastructure as Code on AWS, including AWS CloudFormation and Terraform or OpenTofu
  • 5+ years scripting/programming in Python (building and testing tooling) and Bash/Shell on Linux/Unix
  • 5+ years supporting CI/CD tools (GitHub Actions, Harness.io, ArgoCD, Jenkins, etc.), including reusable/templated workflow design, on GitHub, GitLab, or ADO repositories
  • 5+ years supporting Kubernetes and containerized orchestration
  • Experience delivering CI/CD for data platforms (Snowflake, dbt, Airflow) and working knowledge of MLOps for classical ML and/or GenAI systems
  • Experience in change-controlled or regulated environments (approvals, segregation of duties, policy-as-code, auditable evidence), partnering with Security and Compliance teams
  • Experience designing and documenting DevOps or platform solution architectures with customers or internal teams, including architecture diagrams and design decision records
  • A record of writing runbooks that others used successfully, automating away manual operational work, and building tooling or templates that other engineers chose to use; candidates should be ready to show examples
  • AWS architecture certification preferred




Knowledge/Skills

  • Deep understanding of AWS cloud networking, security, and architecture patterns
  • Proficiency with AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, or GitHub Copilot, including structuring work for AI coding agents (clear specifications, context, task breakdown) and reviewing generated output critically
  • Site reliability and observability skills, including SLIs/SLOs, monitoring and alerting platforms (Grafana, Prometheus, CloudWatch, Datadog or Elastic) and incident management
  • Strong troubleshooting and incident-response skills
  • Strong communication skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, up to executive level
  • Open-minded, collaborative, and adaptive, with an eagerness to learn
  • Preferred: experience with S3 Tables, Glue, Lake Formation, SageMaker and Bedrock
  • Preferred: experience with Harness.io, including templated pipelines, governance policies (OPA) and approval/evidence features
  • Preferred: experience with Astronomer/Airflow operation and upgrades, and with change-data-capture pipelines
  • Preferred: experience with LLM observability, evaluation and cost controls, and with AI agents or MCP-style integrations in engineering workflows
  • Preferred: experience with OIDC/workload identity federation and enterprise secrets/credential management
  • Preferred: experience building internal developer platforms or golden-path tooling

job.title: Senior Business Analyst - Advertising
job.description:
Senior Business Analyst – Advertising Technology & Data

We’re partnering with a leading organisation to find an experienced Senior Business Analyst with a strong background in digital advertising and advertising technology.

Working across Product, Data and Engineering, you’ll help translate complex business and technical challenges into clear requirements, improve advertising workflows and support the evolution of digital advertising capabilities. This role will suit someone who understands the advertising ecosystem, the platforms that power it and the data behind campaign delivery and performance.

The Role

As Senior Business Analyst, you’ll work closely with business and technology stakeholders to understand requirements, analyse existing advertising processes and define solutions that support improved platform capabilities, operational efficiency and data-driven decision-making.

Key responsibilities will include:

  • Leading discovery workshops with Product, Advertising Operations, Sales, Data and Engineering stakeholders.
  • Mapping end-to-end advertising workflows, from campaign setup and ad serving through to impression delivery, performance reporting and billing.
  • Translating advertising and technical requirements into functional specifications, user stories, acceptance criteria and process documentation.
  • Defining data requirements, business rules, KPI calculations and reporting logic across advertising platforms and systems.
  • Analysing existing advertising technology, system integrations and data flows to identify gaps, dependencies and opportunities for improvement.
  • Partnering with engineering and architecture teams to document integration requirements, APIs and technical dependencies.
  • Supporting the development and optimisation of digital advertising capabilities, ensuring business requirements are translated into practical technical solutions.
  • Exploring opportunities to leverage AI and automation to improve advertising operations and business analysis processes.

About You

You’re an experienced Senior Business Analyst with direct experience working within digital advertising, ad tech or programmatic advertising environments. You understand how advertising platforms operate, how campaigns are delivered and measured, and how business requirements translate into technical solutions.

You’ll bring:

  • Proven Senior Business Analyst experience within digital advertising, ad tech, programmatic advertising or advertising technology platforms.
  • Experience working with advertising platforms such as Google Ad Manager or comparable ad serving and campaign management solutions.
  • An understanding of advertising campaign lifecycles, including campaign setup, targeting, ad delivery, impressions, pacing and performance measurement.
  • Experience documenting data requirements, business rules, reporting logic and system integrations within advertising environments.
  • Strong process mapping, requirements elicitation and stakeholder workshop facilitation skills.
  • The ability to translate complex business needs into clear technical specifications, user stories and acceptance criteria.
  • Experience collaborating with Product, Data, Engineering and Architecture teams in Agile delivery environments.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to bring structure to ambiguous business and technical challenges.

Desirable Experience

  • Experience with programmatic advertising and the wider ad tech ecosystem, including DSPs, SSPs, ad exchanges or real-time bidding.
  • Familiarity with advertising measurement, impression tracking, campaign reporting, audience targeting or advertising data platforms.
  • Experience with advertising monetisation models, CPM pricing, campaign billing or impression reconciliation.
  • Knowledge of APIs, SQL, data pipelines and integrations between advertising platforms.
  • Experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini to support discovery, requirements analysis and documentation.

Why Apply?

An opportunity to work on data-led initiatives within a leading Australian advertising business, collaborating across Product, Data and Technology to shape and improve digital advertising capabilities.

If you’re a Senior Business Analyst with hands-on advertising technology experience who enjoys solving complex problems and working at the intersection of advertising, data and technology, we’d love to hear from you.

job.title: Financial Accountant
job.description:
About the Role



We are looking for a capable and hands-on Financial Accountant to join our team in a role that combines traditional finance responsibilities with ERP implementation and business systems support.

This is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys more than just the numbers. Alongside supporting core accounting and finance functions, you will play an important role in the implementation and optimisation of our ERP environment, including Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (D365 F&O) or a similar ERP platform.

You will work closely with Finance, Operations, IT and external implementation partners to help ensure that our new systems, processes and reporting are fit for purpose.

The ideal candidate will be a strong accountant who is also systems-minded, analytical, organised and comfortable working through problems and testing new processes.

Key Responsibilities



Finance & Accounting

  • Support day-to-day financial accounting and finance operations.
  • Assist with month-end and year-end close processes.
  • Prepare and review account reconciliations and financial reports.
  • Assist with general ledger, journals, accruals, prepayments and other accounting activities.
  • Support accounts payable and accounts receivable processes as required.
  • Assist with budgeting, forecasting and management reporting.
  • Identify opportunities to improve financial processes, controls and reporting.
  • Maintain accurate financial records and ensure compliance with relevant accounting standards and internal policies.



ERP Implementation & Systems

  • Support the implementation, configuration and optimisation of Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations or a similar ERP system.
  • Work with Finance and business stakeholders to understand current processes and future requirements.
  • Assist in translating finance requirements into practical system and process solutions.
  • Participate in User Acceptance Testing (UAT), including preparing test scenarios, executing test scripts and documenting results.
  • Identify, investigate and help resolve system issues, data issues and process gaps.
  • Validate financial transactions, workflows, reporting and integrations within the ERP.
  • Assist with data migration activities, including data validation and reconciliation.
  • Review and document business processes and system procedures.
  • Work with implementation partners, consultants and internal stakeholders to track issues through to resolution.
  • Support system cutover, go-live and post-implementation activities.
  • Help develop user guides, process documentation and training materials.
  • Act as a key link between the Finance team and ERP/IT stakeholders.



About You

We are looking for someone who combines strong accounting fundamentals with an interest in technology and business systems.

You will ideally have:

  • Relevant accounting qualifications or significant accounting experience.
  • Experience working in a Financial Accountant or similar finance role.
  • Strong understanding of general ledger, month-end close, reconciliations and financial reporting.
  • Experience with an ERP system such as Microsoft Dynamics 365, Dynamics AX, SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, Pronto, TechnologyOne or a similar platform.
  • An understanding of ERP implementation, system upgrades or process improvement would be highly desirable.
  • Experience with UAT, system testing, requirements gathering or data validation would be advantageous.
  • Strong Excel skills and confidence working with financial data.
  • Excellent attention to detail and a methodical approach to problem solving.
  • The ability to understand both finance processes and how those processes translate into an ERP system.
  • Strong communication skills and the confidence to work with Finance, IT, Operations and external consultants.
  • A proactive attitude and willingness to get involved and solve problems rather than simply identify them.



What We Offer

  • A broad and varied role across Finance and business systems.
  • The opportunity to play a key role in an ERP transformation.
  • Exposure to Microsoft Dynamics 365 and modern finance technology.
  • The opportunity to work closely with senior Finance, Operations and IT stakeholders.
  • A role with genuine scope to improve processes and ways of working.
  • Support and development as you build your ERP and systems expertise.

Qualifications

  • At least five years of successful confirmations management experience within a trading firm, preferably in commodities.
  • Strong experience with master agreements, including ISDAs, NAESBs, EEIs, and related collateral agreements (CSAs).
  • Sound understanding of physical trading, derivatives, and the trade lifecycle.
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with team members.
  • Strong critical thinking and creative problem-solving skills.

  • Excellent organizational skills and the ability to work under tight deadlines.
  • Proficiency in Excel, SQL, and Power BI.
  • Degree in a business or legal discipline.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Python expertise.
  • Experience with Endure or another energy trading and risk management (ETRM) system.
